content.body:
navigation API is for the sole use of the Navigation API.

navigation was originally for the complete navigate algorithm. But not necessarily browsing context creation and such.

frames/navigables/browsing history would cover browsing context creation. And I guess history, I never really read that part... So not sure why we also have a separate history. I wouldn't mind if someone reorganized this a bit.
Does anyone know since when PR Preview is not working for HTML anymore? Did anyone file an issue already?
I think the hosting will move to W3C.
